Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the June 28, 2021, meeting.

  2. California Search K-9 – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  bloodhound tracking services to the Police Department.

  3. South Pacific Heating & Air Conditioning Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend
  payment for providing emergency repairs to the Senor Center.

  4. Gwynne Pugh Urban Studio, Inc. –Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  architectural design services for the City.

  5. Yvette Opara – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for clean-up services
  for the City of Inglewood Homeless Rental Assistance Program.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.
